title: With no filter on the column, ALLSELECTED gives the grand total, and that keeps a row whose own measure is BLANK

source.quote: ignoring any filters that might have been applied inside the query, but keeping filters that come from outside
source.supports: nothing outside filters the products, so every product counts

source.quote: Only rows for which at least one of the supplied expressions return a non-blank value are included in the table returned.
source.supports: Scooter's [Total] is not BLANK, so its row is returned

derivation: Bike 400, Helmet 40 + 20 = 60, Lock 80, Scooter no sales (BLANK). No filter selects products, so ALLSELECTED leaves all of them: 540 on every row. Scooter's [Total] is 540, not BLANK, so its row stays although [Amount] is BLANK.
